create_guider_instance: create a BaseGuidance instance with custom start, stop, and enabled parameters for diffusion guidance
build_guider_copy: build a copy of an existing guider instance with modified configuration parameters using the new method
run_noise_rescale: run the rescale_noise_cfg function to rescale noise predictions and fix overexposure in diffusion outputs
test_guider_state: test the guider state management by setting and retrieving step, timestep, and inference step information
review_guider_preparation: review the prepare_models and cleanup_models methods for setting up and tearing down guidance hooks on denoiser modules
